call connect
@ port baud=9600 data=8 parity=none stop=1 flow=none
> :MountInfo#
@ port baud=115200 data=8 parity=none stop=1 flow=none
> :MountInfo#
< CEM60#
> :GAS#
< 10000011#
  -> Ok(())
  name=iOptron CEM60 (<PORT>) connected=true
call is_slewing
> :GAS#
< 10000011#
  -> Ok(false)
call disconnect
> :Q#
  -> Ok(())
